title: Employment: Growth, Informalisation and Other Issues

concepts.learning_objective: Explain economic activities as those activities that contribute to the gross national product.
Identify who counts as a worker, including the self-employed, helpers and those temporarily absent from work.
Evaluate why unpaid household and farm work of women leads to under-estimation of women workers.
Define and calculate the worker-population ratio.
Interpret differences in worker-population ratio between rural and urban areas and between men and women.
Distinguish self-employed workers, casual wage labourers and regular salaried employees.
Interpret the distribution of workers by status across gender and region.

topics.title: Employment in Firms, Factories and Offices

concepts.learning_objective: Classify the eight industrial divisions into the primary, secondary and service sectors.
Interpret the distribution of the workforce across sectors by region and sex.

topics.title: Growth and Changing Structure of Employment

concepts.learning_objective: Explain jobless growth as a widening gap between GDP growth and employment growth.
Analyse the shift of the workforce from farm to non-farm work over five decades.
Explain casualisation of the workforce and why it makes workers vulnerable.
Classify establishments and workers into the formal and informal sectors.
Describe the conditions of informal sector workers and the effects of informalisation.
Distinguish open, disguised and seasonal unemployment.
Identify how unemployment is defined and the sources of unemployment data in India.
Distinguish direct and indirect employment generation by the government, including MGNREGA.
